Definition: Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
BiblicalUsage: Benjamin means son of the right hand, and he is Jacob's youngest, Rachel's last child, Joseph's full brother. Genesis 35:18 says his dying mother called him Ben-oni, son of my sorrow, but his father called him Benjamin. Genesis 42:4 shows Jacob refusing to send him to Egypt, Genesis 43:29 shows Joseph blessing him at the sight of him, and Deuteronomy 33:12 calls him the beloved of the Lord, who shall dwell in safety by him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Benjamin's story is the story of a name changed at birth: sorrow to right hand, and the beloved of the Lord dwelling in safety.
